model.name: User Admin — thorough merge + delete of profiles / duplicate users (zero dangling refs)
model.description: A User Admin feature that MERGES and DELETES profiles and duplicate users THOROUGHLY — consolidating (merge) or removing (delete) EVERY reference across the graph, leaving ZERO dangling/orphan references, gated by the EXISTING S37 identity-family detectors, dry-run+count+reversible+idempotent, owner-gated. THOROUGHLY is the requirement: profiles.json has been hand-edited + 59+ pollution profiles purged by stop-edit-restart + 3+ duplicate 'Marcel Donges' exist.
model.tronQuote: we need a Feature User Admin that allows merging and deleting profiles and duplicate users thouroughly

discoverySource.note: hand-edited profiles.json; purged 59+ pollution profiles by stop-edit-restart; 3+ duplicate Marcel Donges. Identity/auth family with R40.14/R40.15.

acceptanceCriteria.text: MERGE consolidates EVERY reference, not just the profile row — room memberships, file/unit ownership, device enrollments, alt-identity indexes (phone/email symlinks), avatars, vCards, usedIn side-index.
DELETE leaves NO dangling reference — every ref to the removed user is repointed (merge) or removed (delete).

The completion GATE is a GRAPH QUERY: ZERO dangling/orphan refs after merge or delete, PROVEN by the EXISTING S37 identity-family detectors (orphan-owner / truncated-ref / prefix-collision). REUSE them — do NOT write a parallel checker.
DRY-RUN + counts BEFORE apply; reversible backup; idempotent (the R27.2 / repair protocol).
OWNER-GATED; non-owner => 403 (same integrity argument as R40.10 — if anyone can merge identities, identity means nothing).
